item.title: Education Department to transfer management of defaulted student loans to Treasury
item.description: WASHINGTON — The U.S. Treasury Department will take over the Department of Education’s responsibility for collecting on defaulted federal student loan debt, President Donald Trump’s administration announced Thursday. item.title: No new measles cases in days, health department reports in first for SC outbreak
